idea-plugin.name: Bottom Panel Toggle
idea-plugin.description:
One shortcut to hide and restore the bottom panel in IntelliJ IDEA.

Press Cmd+J on macOS or Ctrl+J on Windows/Linux to hide visible bottom tool windows and return to the editor. Press it again to restore and focus the last used bottom tool window. Side tool windows remain open.

The last used bottom tool window is remembered separately for each open project during the current session.

The standard keymaps also assign these shortcuts to Insert Live Template. Resolve any conflicts in Settings | Keymap.

If no previous bottom tool window is available, the command opens Terminal or the first available button on the bottom tool window bar.

action.description: Hide bottom tool windows or restore the last used one
